notes.title: Update patch September
notes.content:
Bosses should now able to be completed with S-rank.
Weird pause bug is fixed.
Spawn in error is fixed.
Updates to text.
+ a bunch of smaller fixes.

notes.title: Steam deck compatibility
notes.content: The gamis is compatible and playable on the Steam Deck, though the screen aspect is always 16:9.

notes.title: Halloween stream
notes.content: We play the first few levels of Flora & Fang!

notes.title: 2 player gameplay
notes.content: Magnus and a friend play through the beginning of Flora & Fang: Guardians of the vampire garden in two plyer mode.

notes.title: Demo updated
notes.content:
Main issues dealt with:
[list]
[*] Your score is now updated if you get a higher score than the current highscore.
[*] Time stop time doesn't run out if you are paused.
[/list]

+ a number of smaller fixes and balancing.

Thanks for all the feedback!
